issues.title: art/backdrops/mirror-aeons.png answers 404 live, twice per session
issues.summary: GET https://echoesofspira.com/art/backdrops/mirror-aeons.png answers 404, once while the cursor walks to Chapter XXVII's card and once when the chapter's battle starts (both desktop contexts), with a console error each. Nothing visible breaks. Suspected cause (read from the source, not traced): battlePreload.ts phase 3 prewarms plateUrlFor(chapter.sceneKey); the scene key mirror-aeons is a code key and SCENE_PLATES names only sector1-reactor. A vite preview (the proof tool's host) likely answers the missing file with index.html and a 200, which hid it. Smallest fix: map mirror-aeons to art/backdrops/mushroom-rock-road.png in SCENE_PLATES, or skip the prewarm. Acceptance: the same walk on the live host reads 0 responses >= 400 and 0 console errors.
issues.confidence: high that the request and the 404 occur (reproduced in 2 of 2 desktop contexts, curl confirms 404); suspected for the cause

issues.title: Lulu is drawn at 0.67 of her idle height in her hurt painting (and 0.55 in her Critical rest by the table)
issues.summary: Live, Act I first menu, 1600x900: Lulu's silhouette is 226 px standing and 151.7 px in the hurt painting (0.67); Tidus is 1.22 and Yuna 0.78 of theirs. src/data/art/poseRegistrationFfx.ts gives lulu.hurt scale 0.667 and lulu.critical scale 0.533 (the smallest of the seven heroes), a head match from the pose-measure table. ?posereg=off draws the hurt painting at 1.206 x 1.737 (225 px, 99 percent of idle); ?headlock=off changes nothing. The four engine and table files are byte-identical between f939b87f2 and 8a3e8eff7, so every FFX chapter on the previous live build draws her the same. FFX only. Smallest fix: re-measure the two rows from the body, not the head box, and re-run the pose-size gate; paintings untouched. Acceptance: hurt silhouette within about 15 percent of the standing one on the same walk.
issues.confidence: high for the measurement and the table rows; suspected for the head-box cause; the Critical figure is arithmetic from the table, not a captured frame
issues.reportedBy: owner ("lulu looks tiny when hurt - this problem again?", 2026-10-16)
